name: Willowmaker
description: Deadwood punches an enemy with his stump arm, dealing massive Physical Damage scaled by the target's Strength, applying a Stun and a tapering slow, and stealing a portion of their Strength.

source.notes: From hon_reborn_slice.json. Ultimate (slot 4). Damage = 200/400/600 + (target_strength * 0.4 * 21). Stun = State_Stunned_Knockdown, 1500ms. Slow tapering over 5000ms. Grants State_Deadwood_Ability4_Buff to self (40% of target Str) for 7s. Cooldown 100s/80s/60s (3 levels at 6/11/16). Max level 3.

adapted.adaptation_reason: Cooldown: ceil(100s / 5s) = 20 turns (ultimate with very long CD — significant in a card game, needs balance testing). Damage: base 200-600 + bonus based on target Strength (implemented in engine as formula, not flat value). Stun: ceil(1.5s / 5s) = 1 turn. Slow: 1 turn (5s slow → 1 turn). Strength steal: stored as charges on a buff applied to Deadwood. Balance risk: the Strength-scaling bonus damage could be extremely powerful against high-Str heroes — track in test scenario I.
